title: These Cops Don’t Know Who Her Dad Is: ‘All Y'all Are F**king Fired!’
description:
A woman’s night out at a Florida bar prompted a visit from Clearwater police after she began acting disorderly. When officers arrived, she refused to leave the establishment and resorted to insulting police, even trying to pull the “you don’t know who my dad is” card. She was arrested for disorderly conduct and resisting arrest, to which she pleaded guilty.
